candidates.change_summary: Replace the final transfer to owner with a no-op (remove transfer), so contract balance not forwarded back to owner after forwarding to target.
Change the transfer target from owner to msg.sender so the caller receives any leftover balance instead of the contract owner.
Invert the require to revert when the external call succeeds and continue when it fails, altering whether leftover funds are forwarded.
Forward zero value to target instead of the provided msg.value, so the contract retains the sent ETH and then transfers it to owner.
